name: Street Birds
description: 5 kids are working for a dark man called 'Çatal'. They find a baby in a trash bin, and because of Mercan's motherly instincts, they decide to take care of the baby; named 'Gülayşe'. Çatal, the bad guy notices the baby, thus the chaos begins by hurting him and killing a woman accidentaly who was looking for the baby. Frightened kids decide to abandon their territory. Gülayşe, the baby, is the daughter of a wealthy family couple, Bahar and Hafız Eyüboğlu. Her uncle, the boss of Çatal, kidnaps his niece for his agenda. To protect Ali from this murder, the kids agree to tell strangers they are siblings. And, a new life opens its doors when they meet a guy in their own cafe.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As we enter the year 2000, 5 street children in the hands of a man who beg for children: Ali, Mercan, Zıpkın, Sabit, Kara... They manage to become brothers and sisters, defying the treachery of the world. Since they have no roots to hold on to, they cling to each other. The fate of the rootless is changed when they find a baby in the garbage one night. Mercan becomes a mother to the rootless at a young age. Ali is the father… Rootless people who can't take care of themselves try to raise this baby, even if it's with what they find out of the garbage. But it won't be easy. Because the same night is pregnant with a great sin. This secret, which the rootless people will carry on their backs for life, will hurt Ali the most. Both Çatal who begged them and the secret of that night will not leave them. The 23-year-old mystery curtain for these street children who survived by clinging to each other will be reopened when Gülayşe falls in love and Barbaros Commissioner enters their lives...

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Barbaros Commissioner finally kept his promise to Nizam Eyüboğlu and found his daughter Lara. However, baby Lara is not abandoned. She is now Gülayşe of the Firebirds. How will Barbaros manage to separate Gülayşe from her siblings? Firebirds, on the other hand, will face the danger of losing their nests due to lack of identity and money. Can they find a way to avoid ending up on the streets again? In the past, Köksüz Tayfa, who escaped from Çatal and had no roof over their heads, ended up on the streets with a forty-day-old baby. What will the Köksüz family, who became the family of the baby they found in the garbage, struggle to keep their little baby alive?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ateş Kuşları, whose nests are destroyed, are left homeless and return to the streets where they started. Will Ali be able to save his family from the streets this time? In the past, Köksüzler people try to be a family and survive in their first home they built on the top of Istanbul. Zıpkın cannot bear what Gülayşe has suffered and finds a way to bring Mercan to Eyüboğlu mansion as a servant so that the secrets of the past will be revealed. Will this path help them achieve their goals? On the other hand, Gülayşe is surprised to return to the street, her first home after being found in the garbage, and thinks that she has left Barbaros forever. However, Barbaros went after them to take Gülayşe to her father. Although Gülayşe is unaware, Barbaros is watching her at all times.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Ali is trying to protect Gülayşe from Çatal and Mercan and Zıpkın are trying to reunite her with her father, Gülayşe is disillusioned with Yakup and dives into dangerous waters. She enters the fork's lair. She also steals Catal's stash. Mercan and Zıpkın follow the traces of the past in Eyüboğlu Mansion and are determined to prove the culprit. Harpoon's plan begins to work smoothly. But will Eyüboğlu hire Mercan without an ID? Will Zıpkın and Mercan find the woman who trashed Gülayşe that night twenty years ago? Çatal, who is after Gülayşe, is now after her money and is even more dangerous. That money will get Catal one step closer to the Firebirds. The fraternal bond of the Firebirds will give a completely different test this time. In the past, the rootless people who tried to look at Gülayşe as their eyes by running away from Çatal finally got caught. How will the Ateş Kuşları manage to protect Gülayşe this time?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Çatal is after Köksüzler again. Gülayşe is determined to help all children with the money she stole from Çatal. Seeing Gülayşe's stubbornness, Ali finds a solution that destroys Gülayşe's dreams. But it's too late now. Zipkın is ready to break the Köksüzs oath in the mansion he entered with Mercan, secretly from Ali. As long as Gülayşe is reunited with her father! Or will Zipkın burn Ali and tell Nizam all the truth? Barbaros does not allow the homeless Gülayşe to stay on the streets in this cold. He wants to help Gülayşe, but Ali stands against Barbaros. This time, Gülayşe is Ali's target for his love. In the past, Zıpkın and Kara do their best to keep Gülayşe alive. It will not be easy to protect Gülayşe without Mercan and Ali on the streets.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Gülayşe's anger towards Ali darkens her eyes. She asks Barbaros to kidnap her. While Gülayşe and Barbaros, who are riding the dragon, bid farewell to the rest stop, the Fire Birds face losing Gülayşe, whom they cherish. To find Gülayşe, Ali and Zıpkın are after Mete, the person who knows Barbaros. Naz and Menderes are in front of Gülayşe, the baby they left in the trash 20 years ago. The Firebirds' worst nightmare comes true. This time, Gülayşe falls into Çatal's trap. In the past, Ali's plan works and they manage to escape from Çatal's hands. But this time Kara is not there. The same car follows Kara, who is separated from the Firebirds.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Gülayşe wants to live the love story she has dreamed of with Barbaros, even for one day. She will go out to dinner with a man for the first time. He starts preparations with excitement. But the facts that await Gülayşe will turn this fairy tale into a nightmare from which she will want to wake up. The day Nizam has been waiting for finally comes. He is in front of the television. In tears, he calls out to his daughter, who has been missing for years. There is no escape now. Mercan cannot delay Zıpkın any longer. He is at the door to tell Nizam everything. In the past, Mercan creates future dreams for the Köksüzs about the time they grew up. She talks about the man who will appear before Gülayşe as if he has seen these days, unaware of the pain they will experience.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Zümrüt shatters Gülayşe's dreams with Barbaros. Gülayşe is now sitting across from Zümrüt at dinner. So, will Gülayşe accept Zümrüt's marriage proposal for the sake of her family? Şirin's big secret, which she buried years ago, comes to light. Barbaros is the son of Çatal. Barbaros' real test begins now. Will Barbaros learn that his greatest enemy, whom he has been chasing for years, is his father? How will Şirin, who has been hiding this truth for all these years, look at Barbaros' face? In the past, the Köksüzs will follow Sabit's inventive ideas for their only baby, Gülayşe.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Although Gülayşe tries to set herself on fire to protect her family from Çatal, neither Ali nor Barbaros will allow it. This time, Gülayşe stands up against Zümrüt herself to prevent Ali from becoming a murderer. The sharp knife in his hand will either return to Zümrüt or to himself. Gülayşe is finally in front of Barbaros, whom she fell in love with at her first meal. While Barbaros tries to get rid of Çatal's game, Sabit learns Barbaros' big secret. Barbaros is a police officer. So, will Gülayşe learn this secret of Barbaros? While she thinks she has met her love, will this lie be revealed? In the past, a great test awaits the Kökless people. Sabit meets his mother on the streets. Or will a new life begin for the Rootless?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Çatal interrupts Gülayşe and Barbaros' happy moment alone. But Çatal does not kill Gülayşe. He gives Barbaros such information about Gülayşe's past that Barbaros' route changes. Gülayşe, unaware of the circle of secrets around her, dreams of helping orphans with Barbaros. She prepares an iftar table for them. Nizam is now live on the TV they watched while eating together. He calls out to his daughter. All of Gülayşe's attention is on the tearful father on television. Ali is devastated when he learns that Mercan works in the mansion. This time, he was hit by the closest person in his life. He takes his anger with him and abandons the Firebirds. He takes his breath next to Fidan, who emerged from the pages of the past. Mercan will go after Ali as soon as she hears the name Fidan. In the past, Köksüzler, who could not leave Sabit alone with his family, meets Fidan.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Is it the end of the road for the Firebirds? After Nizam Eyüboğlu's live broadcast, the secrets of the Fire Birds are revealed one by one. Barbaros learns that the Firebirds are aware of both Bahar Eyüboğlu's murder and Lara. Barbaros takes action to reunite Gülayşe with her father and makes his first move. He arrests the Firebirds. Now the Firebirds are against Barbaros Tunalı, the commissioner! It's time to reckon with all sins!

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Will Hacer Eyüpoğlu take Gülayşe to her father? The time has come for the Firebirds to face their greatest fears, which they have been running away from for years. Gülayşe is now in front of her aunt Hacer Eyüboğlu. Hacer looks into the eyes of her niece Lara, whom she has not seen for years. Will Hacer, who learns about all the schemes that Mercan and Zıpkın have made to enter the mansion, take Gülayşe to her father? The Firebirds are really facing losing Gülayşe! How will Barbaros protect Gülayşe when all this is happening?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Sabit throws himself in front of a truck due to the pain of losing Gülayşe and everything changes. The great anger of the Firebirds causes Hacer to take a step to understand both them and the past. Panicked when Barbaros discovers Menderes, Çatal decides to tell Barbaros that he is his son. Shaken by Gülayşe's untimely declaration of love, Barbaros cannot bear to continue lying to Gülayşe and begins to tell her the truth. The first step is to say you are a cop.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: While Gülayşe has trusted someone other than the Firebirds for the first time in her life, she has a hard time coping with Barbaros turning out to be a police officer. Barbaros openly confesses his love to Gülayşe for the first time. Gülayşe is very shaken by what she hears. Barbaros begins to open the secret file of Bahar Eyüboğlu murder with new information. The circle becomes narrower for Ali. The recording in the hands of Naz and Menderes will also pull the strings on Ali, but if Menderes is to be punished, Ali is willing to get burned himself and goes after that recording.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Learning that it was his own mother who took the girl he loved from her mother's bosom and kidnapped him, Barbaros maintains his composure in the face of Çatal, but as soon as he leaves there, he suffers a major panic attack. He doesn't know how to look at Gülayşe's face afterwards. Gülayşe brings Sabit and Barbaros together so that Sabit remembers Barbaros and what he has forgotten. His plan works, Sabit starts to remember what happened and tells Gülayşe.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Menderes killing Nermin changes the game for Barbaros and Ali. There is no time to hunt for evidence, Menderes must be put in prison as soon as possible before he goes any further. For this reason, Ali and Barbaros put aside their great hatred for Çatal and offer a deal. Will Çatal accept this agreement? Barbaros wants to fulfill his promise to Nizam Eyüboğlu before anything happens to him. While it is only a matter of time before they catch Menderes, the father begins to take all security measures and take steps to reunite the daughter. First he tells the facts to Nizam Eyüboğlu, and then he tells Gülayşe that he has a father who has been looking for her for years. How will Gülayşe face this truth?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Gülayşe finally reunites with her father and the father and daughter try to get to know each other. But Gülayşe's real test begins now. The secrets that the Firebirds kept from Gülayşe are revealed. Even though they knew that Gülayşe's father was Nizam Eyüboğlu, they hid this from her. This reality, which the Firebirds have feared throughout their lives, is very heavy for Gülayşe and she has to make a choice. Either his family, who raised him but hid his father, will choose the Firebirds and continue his poor life, or he will choose his father, Nizam Eyüboğlu, who has been looking for him for twenty-three years, and choose to live in the mansion of his uncle who threw him away!

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: To protect his daughter, Nizam Eyüboğlu imprisons her in the mansion. But this behavior causes the rebellion of Gülayşe, who cannot see her sister. Will Nizam Eyüboğlu be able to make amends with the daughter he found after 23 years? Barbaros and Gülayşe come on Nizam Eyüboğlu's radar. But Barbaros has no intention of giving up this love, on the contrary, he seeks to purify his love from all secrets. He takes his mother to Sare and withdraws from the case, and confesses to Gülayşe that it was her mother who first took him from his cradle. How will Gülayşe react to this confession? What will happen in the room where Gülayşe was born?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Naz is sure that Menderes' killer is the Firebirds. He attacks Gülayşe with the anger of losing his great love Menderes. This drives Barbar crazy. Sare takes Ali and Zıpkın into custody for questioning about Menderes' murder. He remains alone at the rest stop with his legs unable to hold the coral. Now Mercan is somewhere, Gülayşe is somewhere helpless. Unable to prevent Ali and Zıpkın from being arrested and Mercan being left alone with her disability, Barbar decides to kidnap Gülayşe. The issue of Mercan's surgery becomes more and more unresolved due to the stubbornness of both parties. While Nizam Eyüboğlu wants Gülayşe in exchange for surgery, Mercan gives up her legs to avoid giving Gülayşe.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: It is up to Gülayşe to break the news of Barbaros's mother's death. Barbaros is devastated by this sad news. Will Barbaros believe that his mother committed suicide? Pamir manages to break Çatal out of prison, but Şirin's death turns Naz and Çatal against each other. But Naz has new plans that she wants to share with Çatal. Will Naz be successful? Even though Nizam is very sad about the loss of Barbaros, he comes to Naz's help. He opposes Gülayşe being with Barbaros in the absence of her mother, but the lovers stubbornly resist, and Barbaros even goes further and proposes marriage to Gülayşe. When Nizam hears this, all hell will break loose! So what will Gülayşe do? Will she choose her newly reunited father or the love of her life, Barbaros?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The Firebirds' greatest test begins now. It's back to black! Now is the time for those lost in the darkness of the past to come to light! Kara arrives, carrying all the sins of the Rootless on her back. Pandora's box opens to no longer close. Kara will turn the lives of the Firebirds upside down with the anger she has kept waiting all these years. Everyone will pay the price today for the election made years ago! Will the Firebirds be able to overcome this test or will Kara successfully take her revenge and the Firebirds will be dispersed forever? Gülayşe is like a fairy girl with her flower crown in her snow-white wedding dress, unaware that Kara is descending on the Firebirds like a dark nightmare. She welcomes the wedding guests, hand in hand, eye to eye with the man she loves, plays Harmanda, and shouts yes at the wedding table!

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Kara and Gülayşe are getting married. So, is the love of Gülayşe Barbaros really over? Did Gülayşe bury her love and say yes to Kara for revenge, or is there something else involved? Barbaros saves Gülayşe, whom he abandoned at the wedding ceremony, from the accident. Gülayşe is now all alone, with her father on his deathbed. How will the balance change if something happens to the Nizam?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Zipkın, who goes to the clinic to kill Kara, feels guilty when he sees his "brother" on his deathbed, depending on dialysis. However, Kara does not want the Firebirds to feel guilty, but to pay the price, and makes Zipkın make a cruel choice: "Who should I touch? Hüma or Gülayşe?" As Nizam wakes up in intensive care, he asks Lara to kick the Firebirds out of the Time Out. Will Gülayşe crush her father's wishes on his deathbed or throw her siblings out on the street?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Nazmiye fires Gülayşe from both the company and the house. However, Gülayşe does not accept defeat so quickly. She decides to get a diploma to protect her father's legacy. But until Gülayşe receives her diploma, will there be a company left? Even though Barbaros tries to make Gülayşe forget about him, he cannot leave her alone in this difficult time. How will he support Gülayşe when he can't hold her hand?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Gülayşe is devastated by the death of her father, whom she cannot get enough of, but she has to get back on her feet. Now he will take the reins. As Eyüboğlu's largest shareholder, he is determined to save his father's trust from Kara and Naz. So how will he achieve this when he doesn't even have a diploma?

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Kara's kidney fails. Gülayşe proposes marriage to the man whose days are limited. However, she still keeps Barbaros's ring in her heart, just like her love for him. So, despite all this, why did Gülayşe choose Kara? Won't Barbaros burn all the ships when he hears that Gülayşe said yes to someone else?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: What happens if you take death away from someone who lived to die? Will Kara hold the hand extended by Gülayşe, who wants to give him a reason to live? Even though the wound left in his heart by the Köksüzler is still bleeding, Kara now carries a piece of Ali inside him. And finally he confronts his brothers, who forcibly return the life they took from him. This reckoning gives hope for the future, but how long will it take for the 23-year-old wound to fade? Zıpkın's embrace of Sare, but at the same time, his pursuit of Hüma raises questions. Zipkin must make his decision as soon as possible, because betrayal of love is against the rule of a street child!

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The Firebirds are once again tested with the same test! Which one will Gülayşe choose to save between Zıpkın, who is accused of life imprisonment, and Kara, who was previously abandoned because of him? Or will the youngest of the Rootless come up with a different solution to this impasse?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Just as Çatal is in prison to pay for his crimes, he develops dementia as a result of a clot in his brain and turns into a patient in need of home care. The fact that Çatal forgot everything without paying any price darkens Barbar's world. In these dark days, Köksüzler and Gülayşe do not leave him alone for a moment and try to shed light on his path. So, with Gülayşe's support, will Barbaros agree to take care of the needy man for whom he abandoned the girl he loved?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Barbaros finds Ragıp, the epitome of selfishness, despite all his tricks to escape. However, just as Ali is about to finally regain his identity, he learns something he never expected: He has a sister! Ragıp's only condition for Ali to regain his identity is to find him!

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Barbar is now after Ali's brother. However, looking for this girl whose name they don't know is like looking for a needle in a haystack! Moreover, they need to find the girl before the troublesome guys are after her! Also, even though they don't know it, Nazmiye is determined to find the girl before them!

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Ali has a big confrontation with his father, who has no regrets about selling his children, but he does not give up his good-natured nature. Ragıp is determined to sit at the bargaining table with Gülayşe. So, when Ragıp meets Gülayşe, what will he want from her that is more valuable than money? On the one hand, Barbar admires the heart of the girl he loves, who can do anything for her brother, and on the other hand, he is not going to let Ragıp be happy. That's why he asks Gülayşe for time until he finds a solution. However, while they were talking about these, Nazmiye learned who Ali's sister was before anyone else. What will be Nazmiye's next move? So, who is Ali's sister?

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Ragıp demands something so big in exchange for Ali's identity that everyone goes crazy, but Gülayşe now wants her brother to reach Mercan and her sister as soon as possible. What could Ragıp want so badly? So, will Gülayşe break everyone's words and really give her what she wants? Gülayşe raids Barbaros and Gözde while they are having a romantic dinner and leaves Barbaros! However, this is a game because their love, which has destroyed all obstacles, is not going to be shaken by the wind of a Favorite. It is not easy to separate Barbaros and Gülayşe's hands! While Barbaros is thinking about how to propose marriage, will Nazmiye believe their tricks?

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Barbar is desperately looking for a way to give Gülayşe the beautiful marriage proposal she deserves, but the fact that Ali constantly raises the bar, first with a marriage proposal and now with an engagement, does not make his job any easier! The moment that the Firebirds believed was impossible for years finally comes and Mercan and Ali wear their engagement rings! The only obstacle they have to overcome now is the angel-faced demon Perihan, who stands between them and Mercan's identity!

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Hüma dies and Nazmiye is arrested as the murderer of her own daughter. Zıpkın, Kara and Gülayşe cannot stand that an innocent person is paying the price again and they do something that makes Barbar very angry. What are the Gülayşes up to?

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: While Barbaros is fighting for his life in the hospital, the only thing that gives him strength is Gülayşe's dream. But will this be enough for Barbaros to win the war? Will the Firebirds say goodbye to their best friend Barbaros? Will Gülayşe survive if she loses Barbaros?

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Turgut, who is after the Sultan, kidnaps Gülayşe! Barbaros, who clings to life again with Gülayşe's dreams, wakes up, but Gülayşe, who has been waiting for days for him, does not have the reason to return to life! Now, even if heaven and earth unite to stop him, Barbaros will get out of bed in his sick state and go after Gülayşe! So, will they be able to save Gülayşe? What if Barbaros' body, which stood up just yesterday while searching for him, cannot bear this burden?

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: A new era has begun in the lives of the Firebirds, who have lost everything. They don't even have a roof over their heads anymore. Will Gülayşe, who is even more shaken by her experiences, be able to stand up once again? Barbaros, who tries to support Gülayşe, will have to face a reality that he has been running away from for a long time. On the other hand, how will they hide all this from Ali and Mercan, who are having the happiest days of their lives? What big tests await them where they take a step to hold on to life again?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: While Hacer struggles between life and death, the Firebirds are unaware of the surprising developments that await them. Ali and Mercan, who learn about the difficulties experienced by the Firebirds, albeit late, will take the reins. While Çatal's suspicious situation makes Barbaros think, all eyes will turn to the Sultan. While the Sultan hides in fear, Kara's mistake will corner the Firebirds once again.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: The lives of the Firebirds, who are trying to establish a new order in the neighborhood, will become even more difficult because of the trouble Kara gets into. They will reach out to the neighborhood in a friendly manner to make them forget the unpleasant events, but Seyfi will not remain idle either. Çelik, who thinks that he made a mistake by giving the Firebirds an opportunity, will break the ropes, but this will find Hacer in front of him. A new one will be added to the challenging struggles of the Firebirds in their new neighborhood; Gülayşe will have to choose between her new life with Barbar.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Ateş Kuşları face the fear of losing their homes once again with Barbar being thrown into prison. However, instead of succumbing to Seyfi's blackmail, they are determined to play a big game against him. Learning about the possibility of them leaving the neighborhood, Reyhan invites Hacer, Mercan, and Gülayşe to join the event without her mother's knowledge. While Mercan, Gülayşe, and Hacer are forced to adapt to the atmosphere along with all the neighborhood women, Reyhan has actually set a big trap for Kara. While this trap puts Kara in trouble, it will once again confront Ateş Kuşları with the neighborhood. Despite all Seyfi's efforts, Hacı Hafız gains the respect of the neighborhood with the stories he tells. Sultan, thinking that she is gradually approaching the rich life she dreams of, has a big surprise waiting for her. Commander Çelik is sure that his daughter Ayça is up to something behind his back, and he seeks help from Barbar regarding this matter.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Because of Barbar's promise to Çelik, the tensions between Gülayşe and Barbar are at the breaking point. Will Gülayşe, who is furious with anger, be able to see Barbar's love for her? What is the big surprise that will turn the lives of Ali and Mercan and the Firebirds into a completely different direction? In addition to the surprises and difficulties awaiting both parties, Zıpkın, who is about to go to Ankara to start a new life with Sare, breaks everyone's hearts. This separation will not be easy for either side. Zipkin is brooding with the pain of separation and the question marks in his mind, and things get surprisingly complicated on his side. All hell breaks loose because of Kara, who proposed to Reyhan. The Firebirds find themselves in a brand new adventure before they can get over the shock they experienced. While the women of the house are caught up in a forced rush, the men, under the leadership of Çelik, are busy sailing, fishing and bringing money home.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: The Firebirds' joy when they learn that Mercan is pregnant is replaced by surprise when they enter the house and see what they see. Thinking that he and Sare are people from different worlds, Zıpkın returned from the Ankara road. The resentment between Barbar and Gülayşe lasts for a while, but when the truth comes out, Gülayşe becomes embarrassed. Barbar, who promised Gülayşe the most beautiful marriage proposal in the world, meets his fiancée's jealousy with great maturity and rolls up his sleeves to fulfill his promise. Escape is not that easy for the Sultan, who carries the weight of the murder he committed within himself at every moment and thinks that he can no longer stay with the Firebirds, and runs away from home leaving a letter of confession. On the other hand, Zıpkın, who spends his days like a smiling dead person due to the pain of Sare's separation, has new developments regarding his past.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: While Gülayşe and Barbar are experiencing the most exciting days of their lives, Ateş Kuşları continue their struggle. Thinking they will make a lot of money with Ejderha's new concept, the Ali brothers make big expenses for their siblings' wedding. However, they are unaware of the disaster awaiting them. How will they avoid upsetting Gülayşe and keep their troubles from affecting her? Meanwhile, Mercan, who is aware of Sultan's committed murder but cannot tell others what she knows, is like a time bomb in the middle of the house. In the midst of the wedding rush, Barbar's suspicions about Sultan increase again, and she starts monitoring her daughter. On the Zıpkın and Çelik side, there are new developments that will shock the duo. While one is experiencing the greatest joy of their life, the other will fall into the grip of suspicion and unrest.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: On their honeymoon, Barbar and Gülayşe return to the neighborhood and the reality of life after a dreamy holiday away from their troubles. On one side, the huge debts falling on the Firebirds, and on the other side, the Sultan issue... Hard times await Barbar, who has learned some facts about the Sultan following Cemal's follow-up. So much so that the Sultan issue will cause great destruction between Barbar and Ali and will blow cold winds among the Firebirds. When will this resentment that will leave Mercan, Gülayşe and the whole household in a bind end?

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: A big crossroads awaits Barbar, who reveals the secret kept by the Sultan and shouts to the Firebirds that Çatal's murderer is the Sultan. The fate of the Sultan is now in the hands of Barbar, who is stuck between his family and his profession... Will the Firebirds be able to turn Barbar, who cannot accept his decision, from his path? What kind of trouble will Zipkın get into while trying to reveal the true face of the fake grandson who defrauded Çelik? A threat that has deeply wounded the Firebirds, who have gone through difficult and testing times in the past, is about to re-enter their lives. When and how will the Firebirds confront this threat? Will Seyfi, who takes up sleuthing to understand what is going on in the Firebirds' house, be able to grasp the facts?

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: While the men of the house, especially Ali and Barbaros, were hunting for the kidnapped children under the auspices of the foundation; or are they themselves prey for Çino, whose identity they do not yet know and whom they pursue as prey? In what sneaky way and face will Çino, who learns the truth about Çatal's death, approach the Firebirds? Was Seyfi, who was aware of the murders committed by Kara and Sultan, able to reveal their deceit? What kind of bomb will Seyfi leave in the arms of Ayça, who is holding him accountable for the fake grandson issue? Çelik, who cannot contain himself with the happiness of being reunited with his grandson, Yusuf, will present a great opportunity to the Firebirds. What will be the big shock that Ali will experience as he tries to understand the purpose of Çino who moved to the neighborhood and tries to keep him away from his family?

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Chino, who pretends to save the lives of the Barbarian and the kidnapped children, will gain the trust of the Firebirds. Ali, who knows his true face and never trusts his sincerity, will have a great conflict with the Firebirds and will become increasingly lonely. Çelik will gather his courage and stand against Hacer, and intentions will be expressed on the part of Hacer and Çelik. Ayça, who learns that Kara and Sultan are murderers, will put the couple in a big impasse. Ali will make sure that he is not mistaken in his feelings about the person he sees next to Çino.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: The only goal for Ali, who sees Pamir next to Çino, is to reveal the true face of his old enemy Çino. His impulsive and reckless moves will put Ali in a difficult situation, and the one who will get into the real difficulty in his current state will be Barbar, who serves a greater purpose. The pains that begin to hit Gülayşe's abdomen will bring the same question to everyone's mind... What new developments await the new couple? What will be the last move of Zıpkın, who tries to dissuade Ayça from reporting Kara and Sultan? What kind of trouble will happen to Ali who tries to bring Çino's story to market?

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Gülayşe and Barbar will experience the greatest test of their union, and Gülayşe's tears will tear the hearts of the Firebirds. Trapped by Çino, Ali will find evidence in the shelter he is locked in that will help finish Çino, but someone he never expected will destroy this evidence. The difficulty he and Gülayşe are in will be the key to Barbar's secret mission, but the move he will make will cause a rift between him and his family, especially Ali.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Ali, who is unaware of Barbar's secret mission, will put more pressure on Barbar than ever before, and Barbar will find himself in a predicament he never expected. Gulayşe, who is psychologically devastated due to her illness, will try to push Barbar away from her, but this will not be easy for the duo, who are connected by a great love. A ray of hope will arise for Gülayşe and Barbar to have a baby, and the Firebirds will smile again. A rapprochement arising from the conflict will begin between Kara and Ayça. While Zipkın and Sare are getting engaged; Çino will propose to the Sultan. Will the Sultan accept this offer?

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Barbar's world will come crashing down when he finds out that Çino is his older brother... Barbar's return home, the ice between him and Gülayşe melting, and the possibility of having a child with treatment will make the young couple smile again. The Firebirds, who are on a new quest to pay for the treatment, will find themselves in a new adventure to increase the sales of the shop. Sultan, who runs away with Çino and leaves Ali behind in a devastated state, will pose a great danger for Barbar and his secret mission. Kara, who will spend her days in fear of death due to the joke of Zıpkın and Sabit; What kind of contact will he experience regarding his past and real family?

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Contrary to the Firebirds' prediction, Gourmet praised the meatballs highly and caused a flood of customers in the shop. In the Gülayşe – Barbar wing, where hope rises day by day, the concern about treatment costs decreases a little more. What kind of consequences will Ali and Mercan face when it comes time to learn the gender of their baby? What great danger awaits Çino, who cooperates with the police and becomes a confessor? Which truth will hit the Sultan like a wall when he tries to get information about Kara's family from Çino?

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: While Sultan and Yonca are facing death, Ali's intervention has made things even more difficult. How will they get out of the ring of fire? What will be the outcome of the excited wait of Gülayşe and Barbar, who will take the biggest step towards having a child? What kind of difficulty awaits Kara when she learns who her mother is? The Firebirds are shocked by Ayça's surprise attempt at the meatball shop.
